Firecrawl is a web data company that turns websites into AI-ready data. Developers use its API to convert URLs into LLM-ready markdown or structured data. It gives AI agents a context API to search, scrape, crawl and retrieve clean content from the live web. Its product lineup includes Scrape, which extracts LLM-ready data from websites in formats like Markdown, JSON, and screenshots, plus Search, Crawl, Extract, and Map.

The company grew out of Mendable, an earlier product. Spun out of the Mendable documentation-chat product, Firecrawl handles crawling, rendering, parsing and cleanup so LLM and agent teams do not rebuild extraction pipelines. Mendable was one of the first commercially available "chat with your data" applications. We sold to companies like MongoDB, Coinbase, Snapchat, and more.

**Founders:**
- **Caleb Peffer**, co-founder and CEO. He is a Y Combinator alumnus and serial builder with a background in AI, large-scale data infrastructure, and developer tools. He also co-founded Mendable.ai.
- **Eric Ciarla**, co-founder, listed as cofounder and, in another profile, as Co-Founder and Chief Marketing Officer. He co-founded Mendable in March 2022.
- **Nicolas Silberstein Camara**, founder and CTO according to one profile (Founder and CTO @ Firecrawl).

**Funding (sources conflict):** Seedtable and Preqin list a $14.5M Series A funding, led by Nexus Venture Partners, with participation from Y Combinator, dated August 19, 2025. Dealroom instead reports that in September 2026 Firecrawl raised a $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital. I could not verify the Dealroom figure against a primary source, so treat it with caution.
